title: Beta features
description: Every feature that is still being proven. Turn one on here, or see the exact setting to change when it needs a restart.

banner.title: {{name}} is a beta feature
banner.bodyRestart: It needs a setting and a restart on the server, shown below.
banner.unknown: That feature is not known to this server.

toggle.label: Turn on {{name}}
toggle.lockedByEnv: Turned on by APP_EXPERIMENTAL on the server. Remove it there to switch it off.

env.heading: Turn it on from the server
env.restart: This feature is wired when the server starts, so it needs a restart after you change the setting.
env.systemdHow: Add Environment={{line}} to the control plane unit, then run daemon-reload and restart it.
env.dockerHow: Add -e {{line}} (or the compose environment entry) and recreate the container.

readOnly: Only an administrator can switch beta features.
